notes.title: Update 1.3 A tutorial has been added! - 2018.04.04
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32195520/e9b61ecf872142a57ff4c1b20a835e1c2e48575f.png[/img]
Hello!
I just released a new updated. 

Changelog:

Bug fix - There was a bug where you were not able to use a second gamepad in single player or in the main menu that may result in some people thinking there was no gamepad support.
Bug fix - Some minor level bugs.

Added - I just added a level tutorial. I highly recommend to go back to tutorial even if you already are in the second chapter, some people don't know there is a double jump, a button to roll or even a fight system. To go back to tutorial you just need to go to the first level of the first chapter.

Thanks, we will keep updating the game.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - 2018.22.03
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32195520/439af5daab6dec46ba5e6f9fcd91e289c7336648.png[/img]
Hello!
I just released a new updated. 

Changelog:

[b]Bug fix[/b] - Bridge bug that makes you fall on it.
[b]Bug fix[/b] - Mushroom bug that makes you fall on it.
[b]Bug fix[/b] - A Multiplayer bug that sometimes makes you run with super velocity after die one time.

[b]Improvement[/b] - Perfomance improved by 33%
[b]Improvement[/b] - Difficult recuded by 30% It's still difficult but more like "trial and error" method.

[b]Added[/b] - Window mode added! Enjoy it.

Thanks, we will keep updating the game.
